existing.description: Erasmus+ is the European Union programme supporting projects, partnerships, events and mobility in education, training, youth and sport. Its higher education strand is mainly a student exchange programme that also covers placements in companies abroad and academic staff mobility. Students can spend part of their studies in another country without additional tuition, registration or examination costs and receive a scholarship covering living costs, with the period and courses recognised by their home institution. In Poland the programme is implemented by the Foundation for the Development of the Education System, appointed as the Polish National Agency.
eligibility: Enrolled student or employed staff member at a participating higher education institution
Sending and receiving institutions must hold an inter-institutional Erasmus+ agreement
Mobility must be within the Erasmus+ Programme Countries or an eligible Partner Country
The home institution must recognise the study period and the courses completed abroad
existing.eligibility_summary: Erasmus+ is open to students and staff of institutions in Programme Countries, and mobility is arranged between a sending and a receiving institution that hold an inter-institutional agreement. Students take part of their studies in another country at no additional cost of tuition, registration or examination, and the time spent abroad plus the courses completed must be recognised by the home institution.
benefits: No additional tuition, registration or examination costs at the receiving institution
Graduate mobility for practical training or work placement
coverage: Study abroad without additional costs of tuition, registration or examination
Scholarship covering costs of living abroad (amount set nationally, not published on the pages read)
Support for work placements in companies abroad and academic staff mobility
New option of graduate mobility for practical training or work placement
requirements: Applications are made through the sending university, not directly to the National Agency
The Learning Agreement must be completed for the period before mobility starts
The home institution must accept the period abroad and credit the courses completed
documents: Application to the sending institution's Erasmus+ office
Learning Agreement / Transcript of Records agreed with the sending and receiving institutions
Proof of enrolment or employment at the sending institution
Grant agreement signed with the sending institution or National Agency
application_method: Application through the sending higher education institution's international/Erasmus+ office
Selection and grant award by the sending institution or, in some cases, the National Agency
existing.selection_notes: Not published on the official pages read: Erasmus+ selection is run at institutional level, so criteria and weighting vary by university. The official page confirms only that mobility must be agreed between the institutions and recognised by the home institution.
existing.best_fit: Students and staff at a Polish higher education institution with an Erasmus+ inter-institutional agreement who want a study, placement or staff mobility period abroad.
existing.notes: This row is a programme-level umbrella, not a single call. The stored study.gov.pl page still describes the 2014-2020 funding period and points to http://www.erasmusplus.org.pl/in-poland/, which now returns HTTP 404; the live national agency site is https://erasmusplus.org.pl/. The Polish National Agency is the Foundation for the Development of the Education System (FRSE), not NAWA.
existing.duration: Not specified on the official pages read; mobility periods are agreed bilaterally between the sending and receiving institutions
existing.application_period: Continuous programme with institution-level calls announced each academic year; no single national window is published
existing.deadline_display: No central deadline is published on study.gov.pl or on the Polish National Agency's site. Erasmus+ calls are announced nationally by the Foundation for the Development of the Education System and by each sending or receiving university, so the deadline varies by institution and call.
